source_behavior: Interactive planning produces durable tasks before autonomous execution.
failure_class_addressed: Execution starts against unresolved scope or acceptance.
evidence_from_HCF_history: HCF 1.0 through 2.3 keeps planning and orchestration as separate skills.
current_gap: Planning authority is not one explicit typed profile.
architecture_mapping: Practitioner planning produces passive plan records that compile to LoopGraphDefinition.
migration: Add passive authority and plan contracts behind current Practitioner.
rationale: Preserves one runtime while separating semantic planning authority from effects.

source_behavior: Codebase discovery and assumption enumeration precede questions.
failure_class_addressed: Generic or unnecessary clarification before evidence gathering.
current_gap: Disposition vocabulary and ordering are not one compiled plan contract.
architecture_mapping: Grounded Intelligence work feeds a Practitioner clarification decision.
migration: Add typed dispositions and a bounded discovery-first planning profile.
rationale: Generalizes the information-ordering rule without copying HCF nouns.

source_behavior: Requirements become tests and software work follows red-green-refactor.
failure_class_addressed: Implementation claims success without criterion evidence.
current_gap: No generic criterion-to-verification contract and no admitted optional TDD skill.
architecture_mapping: Universal evidence-first contract plus software-specific admitted skill.
migration: Add passive verification bindings and one candidate skill.
rationale: Evidence-first is universal; TDD is domain-specific.

source_behavior: Ready tasks are grouped into dependency-safe parallel batches.
failure_class_addressed: Serial execution of independent tasks or premature dependent work.
current_gap: Adaptive task planning does not compile typed write/effect-safe waves into the graph.
architecture_mapping: Compile task slices to canonical graph and typed concurrency decisions.
migration: Extend existing scheduling contracts, not a new task executor.
rationale: Loop Engine already owns the stronger graph authority.

source_behavior: Parent resolves one concrete plan path and passes it to workers.
failure_class_addressed: Children resolve different settings or paths.
current_gap: No unified exact WorkerAssignmentEnvelope with all resolved snapshots.
architecture_mapping: Parent Practitioner resolves once and spawns with an immutable handoff.
migration: Compose existing refs into one passive assignment record.
rationale: Directly strengthens existing Spawned Loop boundaries.

source_behavior: Repeated prose resolution was replaced by directly tested executables.
failure_class_addressed: Multiple improvised algorithms drift or partially fail.
evidence_from_HCF_history: HCF 2.1.0, 2.1.1, and 2.2.0 each centralize a resolver.
current_gap: Several concerns still have duplicate or prompt-only resolution paths.
architecture_mapping: One typed resolver and result contract per authoritative concern, invoked by Loops.
migration: Inventory and consolidate concern by concern.
rationale: Adopt the invariant, not HCF shell implementations.

source_behavior: Exit zero plus empty output differs from every failed discovery.
failure_class_addressed: Failure is treated as valid absence.
current_gap: No shared resolution-result taxonomy across concerns.
architecture_mapping: Passive ResolutionOutcome state names used by concern-specific results.
risks: one universal status replacing domain lifecycles
migration: Share the resolution disposition only, preserve domain statuses.
rationale: A small orthogonal taxonomy prevents silent fallback.

source_behavior: Planning captures enrollment and execution refuses material enrollment drift.
current_gap: No composed scoped execution-context fingerprint policy.
architecture_mapping: Several narrow typed fingerprints with explicit materiality decisions.
migration: Build fingerprint components over existing exact refs.
rationale: Loop Engine must hash more semantic content than HCF, but less unrelated prose.

source_behavior: Agent frontmatter declares lifecycle enrollment and one resolver orders it.
failure_class_addressed: Hidden extension activation and inconsistent ordering.
current_gap: No typed procedure-specific LifecycleExtensionDefinition and drift policy.
architecture_mapping: Catalog declarations resolve to one admitted ResolvedExtensionSetSnapshot.
migration: Extend plugin bundle contracts with typed extension definitions.
rationale: Preserve registries; adopt declarative enrollment and one resolver.

source_behavior: Empty hooks produce no work and no user-facing narration.
failure_class_addressed: Configured no-ops consume tokens and flood logs.
current_gap: No extension-specific empty receipt and display suppression policy.
architecture_mapping: Zero work and user silence with optional lightweight canonical event.
migration: Separate internal observation from display projection.
rationale: User-facing silence and internal evidence are independent.

source_behavior: Independent post-plan review finds missing dependencies, activation, testing, and integration.
failure_class_addressed: A plausible plan builds disconnected or unverifiable code.
evidence_from_HCF_history: Devils advocate is the default enrolled extension.
current_gap: No typed PlanAssuranceResult and reusable plan-review procedure.
architecture_mapping: Independent Practitioner review over a passive plan candidate.
migration: Add cross-domain lenses and separate reviewer identity.
rationale: Directly supports honest integration before effects.

source_behavior: Plan files support resume and both complete and blocked are terminal.
failure_class_addressed: Interrupted work restarts blindly or blocked work loops forever.
evidence_from_HCF_history: HCF 2.3 explicitly includes TASKS_BLOCKED in goal completion.
current_gap: No repository/artifact reconciliation before plan resume.
architecture_mapping: ResumeReconciliation Loop checks actual state before continuing.
migration: Keep Run History authoritative and Markdown a projection.
rationale: Loop Engine already has stronger state evidence; reconciliation is missing.

source_behavior: Bounded failed tasks become blocked while independent ready tasks continue.
failure_class_addressed: One failure stops unrelated work or retries forever.
current_gap: Retry policy is not one task-conditioned passive contract in the plan layer.
architecture_mapping: Typed RetryPolicy plus dependency-aware blocked propagation.
migration: Require executable delta and inherited budget.
rationale: Adopt bounded behavior, reject fixed count.

source_behavior: Post-implementation checks and full tests precede commit; push needs user permission.
current_gap: No unified CommitAuthorization and PublishAuthorization contracts.
architecture_mapping: Configurable effect-gate procedure using existing approval authority.
migration: Add passive requests and exact effect binding.

source_behavior: Re-test implementation without extension changes to localize failures.
failure_class_addressed: Wrong contributor blamed for combined regression.
current_gap: No typed ContributionIsolationResult or replay matrix.
architecture_mapping: Independent verifier compares base, contributions, and combination.
migration: Use isolated workspaces and bounded delta-debugging.
rationale: Use the diagnosis pattern without copying broad Git mutations.

source_behavior: Repository development config is separated from generated user configuration.
failure_class_addressed: Product recursively applies its own downstream workflow to itself.
evidence_from_HCF_history: HCF repository config and release history document the correction.
current_gap: No explicit SelfHostingProfile and generated-template provenance gate.
architecture_mapping: Bounded development-assurance profile separate from production task solving.
migration: Label repository config and canonical template sources.
rationale: Protects bootstrap and product development without a new runtime.

source_behavior: Legacy pipeline configuration blocks normal work while migration remains available.
failure_class_addressed: Old and new authorities silently coexist.
evidence_from_HCF_history: HCF 2.0 removes pipeline.md runtime fallback and keeps project-update available.
current_gap: No general typed legacy-authority detection and migration result.
architecture_mapping: Compatibility input only, one canonical source, migration escape path.
migration: Add bounded detection and removal metadata per authority.
rationale: Matches Loop Engine constitutional source-of-truth discipline.
